Test Case Name: Verify CMS Home Page Assignment in Magento Admin Store Configuration
Preconditions: Admin user deepali.londhe@overdose.digital has valid access to Magento Admin panel.
Admin / Storefront Navigation Path: Magento Admin > Stores > Configuration > General > Web > Default Pages > CMS Home Page
Test Steps:
1. Login to Magento Admin panel (godmode/admin).
2. Navigate to Stores > Configuration.
3. Change Scope dropdown to "USA Website" or "GlobeWest US".
4. Expand General > Web > Default Pages section.
5. Inspect the "CMS Home Page" field.
6. Verify "Use Default" checkbox is unchecked.
7. Verify selected value is "Home page - US" (identifier: home-us).
8. Capture screenshot proof.
Expected Result: The "CMS Home Page" dropdown under US scope is set to "Home page - US". "Use Default" is unchecked.
Why It Matters: If the CMS Home page is not assigned under the US scope, the US storefront will fall back to the AU homepage or a 404 page, breaking the US customer entry point.

Test Case Name: Verify CMS Page "Home page - US" (home-us) in Content > Pages
Test Steps:
1. In Magento Admin, go to Content > Pages.
2. In search filter, enter URL Key: "home-us" or Title: "Home page - US".
3. Click Apply Filters.
4. Verify row exists.
5. Verify Status is "Enabled".
6. Verify Scope/Store View includes "USA Website" (or US Store View).
7. Click Select > Edit to inspect content structure and layout.
8. Verify Layout is "1 column" or "CMS Home Page" template.
9. Capture screenshot proof.
Expected Result: Page "Home page - US" is found, Status = Enabled, assigned to USA Website, and contains the required layout/content references.
Why It Matters: Ensures the master CMS container page exists, is enabled, and is strictly restricted to the US scope.
